messages:
Maya: starting 20m change window to enable catalog/orion:v2 in EU. ETA 10:05 UTC. perf tests show ~12% mem increase. if anything spikes we pin back to orion:v1. @deploybot please queue a region-only canary to 5% eu.
Sam: ack. prefer region-only first. can we run 5% eu only, then bump to 20% if stable? also let's set fallback ordering to `orion:v2, orion:v1, sentinel`.
Maya: yep region-only is the plan. @Ashley can SRE watch node memory and latency?
Ashley: SRE here — EU GPU pool has ~15% headroom right now. I'll enable node-level mem watch and alert on >80%.
Maya: @deploybot run canary --model catalog/orion:v2 --region eu --percent 5 --fallback-order "orion:v2,orion:v1,sentinel"
deploybot: Queued canary job 51234. starting in ~60s. will post telemetry to #eng-releases.
Liam: quick runtime note — binary has a small tokenization tweak, p95 may increase ~25-35ms based on bench. recommend a slightly larger routing timeout (add +10s slack) for the canary.
Sam: good call. adding `timeout_ms=15000` to canary route.
Maya: preflight checklist: 1) obs dashboards up 2) canary 5% EU 3) rollback/pin if error rate >1% or p95 +50ms 4) manual rollback vote at +10m.
Ashley: confirmed, dashboards live, alerts enabled.
Sam: initial canary snapshot — 200 requests: err=0.5%, p95 +18ms, mem 68%. looks healthy so far.
Maya: proceed to 20% EU.
deploybot: scaled canary to 20% in eu (job 51234 -> 51234a).
Ashley: Alert: two nodes reporting >85% memory, evicting best-effort pods. mem back to ~82% after eviction. no OOMs yet.
Maya: pause further rollout. Sam, can you pin orion:v1 for EU traffic while we triage?
Sam: applying pin now. `catalog pin set --region eu --model orion:v1 --reason "memory concern during orion-v2 rollout" --expires 1h` — pin applied, rolling traffic back to orion:v1.
deploybot: Pin applied. Canary job 51234a stopped, traffic reverted to orion:v1.
Maya: thanks. we'll open follow-up to quantify mem delta and test quant/profile. release note draft: "orion-v2 attempted EU canary up to 20% — rollout paused due to elevated node memory; traffic pinned to orion:v1. follow-up investigation (INF-2345) opened to determine mem regression and latency variance."
Liam: I'll run binary diff + perf with larger batch sizes and full KV-cache warmup.
Ashley: we'll replay traces from the canary window and check allocator churn.
Maya: closing window early. recording ticket INF-2345 for investigation and follow-up canary next week after mitigations. I'll post the release note to #release-notes and tag product.
Sam: also adding a console change: make canary timeout and fallback-order explicit defaults so next rollouts don't assume older behavior.
Maya: :thumbsup: good work everyone. ending thread.
